paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THESE men's great bounty hath been manifested, and the whole world of life set free from darkness.
paragraphs.original: आविरभून्महि माघोनमेषां विश्वं जीवं तमसो निरमोचि ।
paragraphs.translit: āvirabhūnmahi māghonameṣāṃ viśvaṃ jīvaṃ tamaso niramoci |

paragraphs.text: Great light hath come, vouchsafed us by the Fathers: apparent is the spacious path of Guerdon.
paragraphs.original: महि ज्योतिः पितृभिर्दत्तमागादुरुः पन्था दक्षिणाया अदर्शि
paragraphs.translit: mahi jyotiḥ pitṛbhirdattamāgāduruḥ panthā dakṣiṇāyā adarśi

paragraphs.text: 2. High up in heaven abide the Guerdon-givers: they who give steeds dwell with the Sun for ever.
paragraphs.original: उच्चा दिवि दक्षिणावन्तो अस्थुर्ये अश्वदाः सह ते सूर्येण ।
paragraphs.translit: uccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthurye aśvadāḥ saha te sūryeṇa |

paragraphs.text: They who give gold are blest with life eternal. they who give robes prolong their lives, O Soma.
paragraphs.original: हिरण्यदा अमृतत्वं भजन्ते वासोदाः सोम प्र तिरन्त आयुः
paragraphs.translit: hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pra tiranta āyuḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Not from the niggards-for they give not freely-comes Meed at sacrifice, Gods' satisfaction:
paragraphs.original: दैवी पूर्तिर्दक्षिणा देवयज्या न कवारिभ्यो नहि ते पृणन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: daivī pūrtirdakṣiṇā devayajyā na kavāribhyo nahi te pṛṇanti |

paragraphs.text: Yea, many men with hands stretched out with Guerdon present their gifts because they dread dishonour.
paragraphs.original: अथा नरः प्रयतदक्षिणासोऽवद्यभिया बहवः पृणन्ति
paragraphs.translit: athā naraḥ prayatadakṣiṇāso'vadyabhiyā bahavaḥ pṛṇanti

paragraphs.text: 4. These who observe mankind regard oblation as streamy Vayu and light-finding Arka.
paragraphs.original: शतधारं वायुमर्कं स्वर्विदं नृचक्षसस्ते अभि चक्षते हविः ।
paragraphs.translit: śatadhāraṃ vāyumarkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasaste abhi cakṣate haviḥ |

paragraphs.text: They satisfy and give their gifts in synod, and pour in streams the seven-mothered Guerdon.
paragraphs.original: ये पृणन्ति प्र च यच्छन्ति संगमे ते दक्षिणां दुहते सप्तमातरम्
paragraphs.translit: ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti saṃgame te dakṣiṇāṃ duhate saptamātaram

paragraphs.text: 5. He who brings Guerdon comes as first invited: chief of the hamlet comes the Guerdon-bearer.
paragraphs.original: दक्षिणावान्प्रथमो हूत एति दक्षिणावान्ग्रामणीरग्रमेति ।
paragraphs.translit: dakṣiṇāvānprathamo hūta eti dakṣiṇāvāngrāmaṇīragrameti |

paragraphs.text: Him I account the ruler of the people who was the first to introduce the Guerdon.
paragraphs.original: तमेव मन्ये नृपतिं जनानां यः प्रथमो दक्षिणामाविवाय
paragraphs.translit: tameva manye nṛpatiṃ janānāṃ yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇāmāvivāya

paragraphs.text: 6. They call him Rsi, Brahman, Sama-chanter, reciter of the laud, leader of worship.
paragraphs.original: तमेव ऋषिं तमु ब्रह्माणमाहुर्यज्ञन्यं सामगामुक्थशासम् ।
paragraphs.translit: tameva ṛṣiṃ tamu brahmāṇamāhuryajñanyaṃ sāmagāmukthaśāsam |

paragraphs.text: The brightly-shining God's three forms he knoweth who first bestowed the sacrificial Guerdon.
paragraphs.original: स शुक्रस्य तन्वो वेद तिस्रो यः प्रथमो दक्षिणया रराध
paragraphs.translit: sa śukrasya tanvo veda tisro yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇayā rarādha

paragraphs.text: 7. Guerdon bestows the horse, bestows the bullock, Guerdon bestows, moreover, gold that Rsisters.
paragraphs.original: दक्षिणाश्वं दक्षिणा गां ददाति दक्षिणा चन्द्रमुत यद्धिरण्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: dakṣiṇāśvaṃ dakṣiṇā gāṃ dadāti dakṣiṇā candramuta yaddhiraṇyam |

paragraphs.text: Guerdon gives food which is our life and spirit. He who is wise takes Guerdon for his armour.
paragraphs.original: दक्षिणान्नं वनुते यो न आत्मा दक्षिणां वर्म कृणुते विजानन्
paragraphs.translit: dakṣiṇānnaṃ vanute yo na ātmā dakṣiṇāṃ varma kṛṇute vijānan

paragraphs.text: 8. The liberal die not, never are they ruined: the liberal suffer neither harm nor trouble.
paragraphs.original: न भोजा मम्रुर्न न्यर्थमीयुर्न रिष्यन्ति न व्यथन्ते ह भोजाः ।
paragraphs.translit: na bhojā mamrurna nyarthamīyurna riṣyanti na vyathante ha bhojāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The light of heaven, the universe about us,-all this doth sacrificial Guerdon give them.
paragraphs.original: इदं यद्विश्वं भुवनं स्वश्चैतत्सर्वं दक्षिणैभ्यो ददाति
paragraphs.translit: idaṃ yadviśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ svaścaitatsarvaṃ dakṣiṇaibhyo dadāti

paragraphs.text: 9. First have the liberal gained a fragrant dwelling, and got themselves a bride in fair apparel.
paragraphs.original: भोजा जिग्युः सुरभिं योनिमग्रे भोजा जिग्युर्वध्वं या सुवासाः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhojā jigyuḥ surabhiṃ yonimagre bhojā jigyurvadhvaṃ yā suvāsāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The liberal have obtained their draught of liquor, and conquered those who, unprovoked, assailed them.
paragraphs.original: भोजा जिग्युरन्तःपेयं सुराया भोजा जिग्युर्ये अहूताः प्रयन्ति
paragraphs.translit: bhojā jigyurantaḥpeyaṃ surāyā bhojā jigyurye ahūtāḥ prayanti

paragraphs.text: 10. They deck the fleet steed for the bounteous giver: the maid adorns herself and waits to meet him.
paragraphs.original: भोजायाश्वं सं मृजन्त्याशुं भोजायास्ते कन्या शुम्भमाना ।
paragraphs.translit: bhojāyāśvaṃ saṃ mṛjantyāśuṃ bhojāyāste kanyā śumbhamānā |

paragraphs.text: His home is like a lake with lotus blossoms, like the Gods' palaces adorned and splendid.
paragraphs.original: भोजस्येदं पुष्करिणीव वेश्म परिष्कृतं देवमानेव चित्रम्
paragraphs.translit: bhojasyedaṃ puṣkariṇīva veśma pariṣkṛtaṃ devamāneva citram

paragraphs.text: 11. Steeds good at draught convey the liberal giver, and lightly rolling moves the car of Guerdon.
paragraphs.original: भोजमश्वाः सुष्ठुवाहो वहन्ति सुवृद्रथो वर्तते दक्षिणायाः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhojamaśvāḥ suṣṭhuvāho vahanti suvṛdratho vartate dakṣiṇāyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Assist, ye Gods, the liberal man in battles: the liberal giver conquers foes in combat.
paragraphs.original: भोजं देवासोऽवता भरेषु भोजः शत्रून्समनीकेषु जेता
paragraphs.translit: bhojaṃ devāso'vatā bhareṣu bhojaḥ śatrūnsamanīkeṣu jetā
